name: Perfected
body:
The Perfected are an order of bloodstalkers who believe their given forms are nothing more than a starting point from which they can improve and eventually become the most efficient of their kind. They study the creation of constructs and adapt those teachings to modify themselves as they gain experience, accepting the heavy cost that comes with eventually becoming living golems themselves.

Altered State (Ex)

When a bloodstalker joins this order at 3rd level, he imbibes an altered stalker’s draught that changes the chemical makeup of his mind and body. He adds his stalker’s drought bonus on all Fortitude saves (unless the effect also works on objects or is harmless), and on Will saves he makes against mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, morale effects, patterns, and phantasms).

At 11th level, the bloodstalker becomes immune to mind-affecting effects, but he can no longer be raised or resurrected except by a carefully worded miracle or wish.

He can still be returned to life with a reincarnate spell, but loses the benefits of this order until he can spend 1 week per bloodstalker level modifying his new body once more (if he has access to an appropriate lab and tools, the bloodstalker can reduce this to 1 day per bloodstalker level instead).

He can also still be healed by spells such as breath of life because those effects technically prevent his death, instead of outright resurrecting him.

At 19th level, The bloodstalker no longer has a Constitution score (Con –), but he gains 20 bonus Hit Points (10 if he’s Small or smaller, 30 if he’s Large or larger). He also becomes immune to effects that require a Fortitude save unless the effect is harmless or works on objects, and he can’t be healed normally. When the bloodstalker would take electricity damage, he heals for half that amount instead.

He can also be healed by spells that repair constructs, such as make whole. If he somehow gains fast healing or regeneration, those abilities function normally for the bloodstalker.

Artificial Upgrades (Ex)

At 7th level, the bloodstalker has modified his physical body as well as his chemical makeup. He gains a +2 natural armor bonus. At 15th level, he is no longer required to breathe, eat, or sleep, unless he wants to gain some beneficial effect from one of these activities. This means the bloodstalker can drink potions to benefit from their effects and can sleep in order to regain spells, but neither of these activities is required for him to survive or stay in good health.
